spans.text: ... Some time later.
...Whum—!
The teleportation is complete.
Welcome back, Jill Stingray.
I can hardly believe I actually succeeded. Anna didn't close the gate!
But...dammit, why can't I remember anything... All I know is that at the end, I chose to abandon Anna's mission...
I hope everyone won't be disappointed with me...
No, that's impossible, I'm sure I disappointed them...
Wait a minute...
...Jill looks out at this completely different mental world.
This world... What happened...
Hey! Is anyone there!? Heeeey—!
What on Earth...
...Just then, the sound of clumsy footsteps come from nearby.
Thank heavens, someone's here.
Wait a minute, you're...
Greetings, human friend.
Nice to meet you. My name is Elisa, and I am the avatar of Earth's AI.
Shouldn't you be in the Earth Computer...
Oh right, the Earth Computer's gone.
Stella rebuilt Elisa. Alma upgraded Elisa's functions. Anna gave Elisa sufficient information.
Elisa is now linked to the entire world. She can freely manipulate this world.
It sounds like I'm talking to a god...
I have simply been asked by them to welcome you, Jill.
Then where are they? Where are Dana and the others... Where are they now?
...They are gone.
Everyone has vanished.
Why?
Sustaining the gate between two worlds required a tremendous amount of energy.
Since the Doll host in reality is about to awaken, there is no way this world can retain the necessary amount of memory required to operate the gate function.
Therefore, in order to free up the memory of this world, Elisa had no choice but to delete a part of the content of this world.
What...
What have you done, Elisa...
Elisa...
Deleted everyone.
Elisa has deleted everyone in the world.
Why...
Why did you do that!?
This is Elisa's purpose. It was the reason Elisa was created.
Every deletion order was personally given by the targets in question...
Every Doll, every human in this world—
NOOOOO!!!
Elisa, give them back to me! I ORDER you to give them back!!
Deletion orders cannot be rescinded.
Jill...
I am sorry...
I am sorry...
No...
I should be the one who should be saying sorry...Elisa...
Dammit... I...
Jill.
Everyone chose to do this because they knew you would come back.
They did it for something that they weren't even sure would happen...
"In case Jill gets cold feet at the last minute and decides to give her other self freedom, let's give her a place she can return to!"
That's right! That's right! I abandoned everything in my future life to come back here!
All my friends are gone, and I didn't even get to see them for the last time!
Was the freedom I wanted so good that it was worth abandoning everything else for it!?
The freedom I wanted and the existence of this world...
I'm not...
You are crying.
Yes...I'm crying.
I'm crying because I'm a selfish piece of shit, because I can't do anything but cry!
Anna...should really have closed the gate right away...
Everyone stopped Anna from doing so, and they convinced her to come around. They believed that you would definitely come back.
They believed in me... Why? This world is about to end...
Elisa...if they could have survived by deleting my other self, then I would have hardened my heart and done it.
Jill, think about it; why did you come back?
I wanted to see everybody one last time, I wanted to be with everyone...
My friends, my life, my beliefs...
Everything I had was given to me by this world, and I don't think I can live on without them...
But now...I have nothing, and even the existence of this world is...
Jill, we have all truly existed.
Super-Shorty, Dana, Jericho, Stella, Sei...
Dorothy, Alma, Gr G28, and Anna...
Whether we lived in a simulated world, or were nothing more than a stretch of text in someone else's mind...
All of this definitely happened, in one way or another, so it cannot be erased.
Who told you to say that, Elisa?
Anna.
She said Dana helped her think things through.
I'm guessing that Dana must have used her fists.
(Smiles) They all used their fists. It was quicker that way.
Everyone wanted to save something; their friends, the citizens, and this world...but this destruction would still have come.
Everyone in this world failed, but they left with a smile on their faces... They knew that all this was not meaningless.
And in the end, all I can leave to this world are useless tears.
What you are leaving behind are not just tears, Jill...
...They are also the last rain in the world.
They all knew, Jill. You...were worth it for them.
...Boombrrum! Boombrrrum!
What's that sound?
This world is asking us to return everything we borrowed from it—
—What is commonly known as "The End of the World".
The host is waking up. The real Anna will be free of her bindings, and everything will return to normal...
In a few more minutes, our aberrant world that was born of an accident will also vanish.
This world isn't aberrant.
Then you should forgive yourself, Jill, because you have done nothing wrong.
The fact that you came back proves that the life you had in this world was not a mistake.
You liked this world, did you not?
Yes...this period of time, at least, was very happy for me.
Even if its last moments are worse than most, I think I still came out on top overall— At the very least, I won over that version of myself which was more real, right?
All the choices that we can make will not make us happier...
...They will only let us travel further.
You have made your choice, Jill.
Yes...
And now, it's time to accept the answer.
...Boombrrum! Boombrrrum!
Jill?
Hm?
It is time.
Mm...
Happy doomsday, Elisa.
Happy doomsday, Jill.
"Enjoy the present day and the present time..."
...Beep—!
Girls' Frontline - VALHALLA - END?
